title: Pipeline by the numbers
caption: Many leads go in. A long wait comes out.
illustration: Illustration of a complex sale, not a benchmark

measured-one-dataset.description: In a dataset of 655 thousand opportunities across 387 companies, the new-customer win rate was 19 percent, the sales cycle 91 days and 8 stakeholders per deal; for expansion sales to existing customers it was 45 percent, 52 days and 5 stakeholders.[1]

ebsta-pavilion.title: Ebsta and Pavilion, GTM Benchmarks Report

most-losses-are-no-decision.description: An analysis of more than 2.5 million sales conversations found that 40 to 60 percent of deals are lost to buyers who intend to buy but never act.[1]

hbr-indecision.title: Dixon and McKenna, Stop Losing Sales to Customer Indecision (Harvard Business Review)

the-buyer-is-a-group.description: A Gartner survey of 632 B2B buyers describes buying groups of five to 16 people, and 74 percent of buyer teams showed unhealthy conflict.[1]

gartner-buyer-teams.title: Gartner, Gartner Sales Survey Finds 74% of B2B Buyer Teams Demonstrate "Unhealthy Conflict" During The Decision Process

illustration.title: Illustration
illustration.keywords: a complex sale, illustration not benchmark, your numbers differ
illustration.script: Here is an example of a complex sale. It is an illustration, not a benchmark. Your numbers will differ. But it shows how the arithmetic behaves.

ratios-multiply.title: Ratios multiply
ratios-multiply.keywords: three to one, nine to one, twenty-seven leads per deal
ratios-multiply.script: Three leads become one opportunity. Nine opportunities become one deal. Multiply it out and you need twenty-seven leads for a single deal. Small ratios at each stage add up to a very big number at the top.

time-adds-up.title: Time adds up
time-adds-up.keywords: two weeks, six months, three months, most of a year
time-adds-up.script: Now the time. Two weeks for the first stage. Six months for the second. Three months for the third. Add them up and revenue lands most of a year after the first contact. A year is longer than most founders' cash.

measured-sits-beside-it.title: Measured sits beside it
measured-sits-beside-it.keywords: a real dataset, shorter cycle, your own numbers
measured-sits-beside-it.script: Beside it sits a real, measured dataset. Its cycle is much shorter than the illustration's. Still, it is one dataset from other companies. Your own numbers will tell you more than any of these.

so-fill-early.title: So fill early
so-fill-early.keywords: many leads in, long wait out, start filling now
so-fill-early.script: Many leads go in. A long wait comes out. If that is true for you, you have only one move. Start filling the pipeline now, while you still have cash to wait with.
